'''Subject 476''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.<ref name="FalloutTV">{{fotv|1|6}}</ref>

==Background==
It is unknown when or how Subject 476 came to Vault 4, but she was among its numerous test subjects.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Subject 476 is the woman on the holotape recording on [[Vault 4]]'s level 12, giving birth to a spawn of baby [[gulper (TV series)|gulpers]]. Immediately after birth, the baby gulpers turn around and start consuming Subject 476 in a piranha-like manner.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

==Appearances==
Subject 476 appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
